description: Real-recording and annotated-synthetic transcription benchmark. Synthetic fixtures (syn_*) are always generated deterministically. Real fixtures (real_*) are optional until a recording + annotation JSON are placed in fixtures/real/. See benchmarks/RECORDING_PROTOCOL.md for how to record and annotate.

fixtures.description: Open note per string E2→E4 (synthetic sine, 500ms each)

expect._note: Baseline: recall=0.50, prec=0.50, ghost=0.50. Thresholds are regression guards at ~70% of observed.

fixtures.description: E2 repeated 4 times, 400ms each with 200ms gaps

expect._note: Baseline: recall=1.00, ghost=0.67 (ringing false detections). Guard recall, allow high ghost rate.

fixtures.description: A minor pentatonic ascending (A2, C3, D3, E3, G3, A3)
E minor arpeggio (E2, B2, E3, G3, B3, E4)
E minor open chord — all 6 strings simultaneously

expect._note: Baseline: recall=0.00, ghost=1.00. Basic Pitch cannot detect any notes from summed chord sines; all detected events are harmonic artifacts. No pass threshold — this documents the known polyphonic chord detection failure.

fixtures.description: F major barre chord (fret 1): F2, C3, F3, A3, C4, F4
E minor pentatonic run at 160 BPM (8th notes, ~187ms apart)

expect._note: Baseline: recall=0.33, prec=0.50, ghost=0.50. Basic Pitch minimum note length merges fast adjacent notes.
Baseline: recall=1.00, ghost=0.50 (pitch ramp creates one extra detected event).

fixtures.description: Hammer-on pair: E3 (picked 80ms) → G3 (hammered, low amp)

expect._note: Baseline: recall=0.50, prec=0.50, ghost=0.50. Short picked note often not detected.

fixtures.description: Isolated string notes at 1/10 amplitude (peak ~0.045, ~-27 dBFS)

expect._note: Baseline: recall=0.50, ghost=0.50. Backend normalization successfully amplifies quiet input (same result as normal isolated strings).

fixtures.description: Isolated string notes with Gaussian noise (std=0.025, ~15 dB SNR)

expect._note: Baseline: recall=1.00, ghost=0.14. Gaussian noise does not significantly degrade Basic Pitch detection.

fixtures.recordingProtocol: Open low E string (E2, MIDI 40). Record 4 clean plucks with ~0.5s gaps. Quiet room, laptop microphone, no effects, no amp modelling. Annotate each onset in iso_low_E.json with the exact ms from the WAV.
Open A string (A2, MIDI 45). Same protocol as real_iso_low_E.
Open D string (D3, MIDI 50). Same protocol as real_iso_low_E.
Open G string (G3, MIDI 55). Same protocol as real_iso_low_E.
Open B string (B3, MIDI 59). Same protocol as real_iso_low_E.
Open high e string (E4, MIDI 64). Same protocol as real_iso_low_E.
A natural minor scale ascending from A2 (fret 0 string 5) to A4. Play at a moderate tempo (~80 BPM quarter notes). Single strokes, no bends or vibrato.
A natural minor scale descending from A4 down to A2. Same conditions as scale_ascending.
Open low E string struck 4 times with ~500ms between each strike. Let each note fully decay before the next.
E minor arpeggio: pluck strings 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 individually in sequence from an open Em chord shape. Each string should ring (~300ms per note).
Open Em chord (all 6 strings): play 2 clean strums with ~1s between them. Strum quickly so all strings sound as simultaneously as possible.
Open G chord: 2 strums. Standard G voicing (low G on string 6 fret 3).
F major barre chord at fret 1: 2 strums. Full 6-string barre voicing (F, C, F, A, C, F low to high).
Bm barre chord at fret 2: 2 strums. Standard Am-shape barre on strings 2-6.
E minor pentatonic run at 160 BPM (8th notes). At least 8 notes. Use a metronome. Alternate picking preferred.
Whole-step bend on string 2 (B string): bend from fret 7 (F#4, MIDI 66) up to fret 9 pitch (G#4, MIDI 68). Play 3 separate bends with 0.5s between. Hold each bend at the top for ~300ms.
Slide on string 1 (high e): from fret 5 (A4, MIDI 69) slide to fret 7 (B4, MIDI 71). Play 3 slides. Keep pick in contact with string throughout.
Hammer-on on string 2: pick fret 5 (E4, MIDI 64), hammer onto fret 7 (F#4, MIDI 66). Play 4 pairs with ~0.5s between. The hammered note should be clearly audible.
Pull-off on string 1: fret both fret 7 (B4, MIDI 71) and fret 5 (A4, MIDI 69), pick fret 7, pull off to fret 5. Play 4 pairs. Both notes must be audible.
Vibrato on string 1, fret 7 (B4, MIDI 71): sustain the note for 1s while applying consistent vibrato (at least 4 oscillations). Play 3 separate notes with vibrato.
Palm-muted power chord on strings 5-6 (A2/E2): play 4 muted strikes at 120 BPM quarter notes. Note onset should still be clearly detectable despite short sustain.

Isolated string notes (same as real_iso_low_E) but played softly (fingerpicking or very light pick attack). Target recording peak < 0.1 (-20 dBFS) before any normalization. Tests the backend gain boost.
Same as real_iso_low_E but recorded with moderate background noise (fan, keyboard, or light conversation in background). Tests robustness to realistic recording conditions.
